items.title: Localizing a special cocontinuous functor stays special cocontinuous

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a special cocontinuous functor restricts to a special cocontinuous functor between the localized sites, so that the corresponding vertical arrows in the commutative diagram of topoi are equivalences (statement lines 7118-7141). The proof is a complete verification of the five conditions of the equivalence criterion for the induced functor: cocontinuity and continuity (proof lines 7151-7158), the two lifting conditions (proof lines 7161-7189) and the covering condition (proof lines 7190-7195), each obtained from the corresponding property of the original functor by refining coverings. The non-formal content is the reduction of each condition to the ambient one. The claim is H2: a structured verification with every hypothesis used explicitly.
